name: Template: Sales Pipeline
description: Track deals from first contact through close. Each swimlane represents a prospect account.

swimlanes.name: TechNova Inc
swimlanes.notes: Series C SaaS company — 500 seats target. Champion: VP Engineering.

swimlanes.name: BlueRidge Financial
swimlanes.notes: Compliance-heavy financial firm. Procurement is slow — expect 90-day cycle.

swimlanes.name: Apex Retail
swimlanes.notes: Mid-market retail chain. Seasonal budget freeze Dec–Feb. Decision maker: CTO.

swimlanes.name: Meridian Health
swimlanes.notes: Healthcare network — HIPAA BAA required. 200-seat potential. Long procurement cycle.

swimlanes.name: Summit Logistics
swimlanes.notes: Fast-moving mid-market. Decision in < 2 weeks. 25-seat deal.

cards.title: Intro call with VP Engineering
cards.description:
## Goal

Establish rapport and identify pain points with current project tracking tooling.

## Key questions

- How many teams would use Visiban?
- What does the current Jira setup look like?
- Who has budget authority?

comments.body: Confirmed for Thursday 2pm PT. Sam will join as SE.
comments.author: demo1

comments.body: They mentioned migrating off Jira — this is a strong signal.
comments.author: demo2

cards.title: Product demo: board visualization
cards.description:
Run the standard board demo tailored to engineering use case. Focus on swimlane-per-team, WIP limits, and the analytics view.

Time-box to 45 min. Leave 15 min for Q&A.

checklist.text: Customise demo board with TechNova branding

comments.body: Demo went well. They loved the card movement history view.
comments.author: demo1

comments.body: Action item: send pricing deck by EOD Friday.
comments.author: demo2

cards.title: Security review questionnaire
cards.description:
TechNova InfoSec requires a completed vendor security questionnaire before legal can proceed.

## Required sections

- Data residency and encryption at rest
- SOC 2 Type II report (attach)
- Pen test summary (last 12 months)
- Incident response SLA

checklist.text: Get pen test summary signed off

comments.body: Jordan filled out sections 1–4. Waiting on InfoSec to countersign the pen test summary.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Legal review of MSA
cards.description:
Master Service Agreement sent to TechNova legal on 2026-03-10. Their counsel requested two redlines:

1. Liability cap: 2× ARR (we proposed 1×)
2. Data deletion timeline: 30 days (we proposed 90 days)

Escalate to VP Sales if no resolution by due date.

checklist.text: Review their redlines with legal counsel

comments.body: Legal: we can accept 2× ARR cap. Holding on 30-day deletion — check with engineering.
comments.author: demo1

comments.body: Engineering confirmed 30 days is feasible. Updating counter-proposal.
comments.author: demo2

cards.title: Confirm pilot program (50 seats, 90 days)
cards.description:
TechNova signed. Pilot starts 2026-04-01 with the Platform Engineering team (50 seats). Success criteria agreed:

- ≥70% weekly active users
- NPS ≥ 40 at 45-day check-in
- Expand to full org if criteria met

comments.body: Pilot confirmed! Handoff to CS team — assign to Casey.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Cold outreach — CISO intro
cards.description:
Initial outreach via LinkedIn to CISO Sarah Ng. Referenced their recent SOC 2 certification news.

Follow up with email if no response in 5 business days.

cards.title: Discovery call completed
cards.description:
30-min call with CISO and IT Director. Pain: current spreadsheet tracking breaks down for cross-team work.

They need on-prem or private-cloud option — flag for product team.

comments.body: Strong interest but private cloud is a hard requirement for them.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Compliance questionnaire review
cards.description:
BlueRidge sent a 47-page compliance questionnaire. Sections covering PCI-DSS, GDPR, and FINRA record-keeping.

Coordinate with legal and InfoSec to complete.

checklist.text: Route to InfoSec for FINRA section
PCI-DSS section — confirm scope with engineering

comments.body: OVERDUE — InfoSec is backed up. Escalated to CTO.
comments.author: demo1

comments.body: CTO approved expedited review. Engineering confirmed PCI out-of-scope.
comments.author: demo2

cards.title: Negotiate SLA terms
cards.description:
BlueRidge requires 99.95% uptime SLA with financial penalties. Current standard offer is 99.9%.

Options:
1. Upgrade to enterprise tier (99.95% SLA included)
2. Custom SLA addendum at +15% ACV

checklist.text: Send final pricing with SLA options

comments.body: VP approved enterprise tier upgrade path. Drafting addendum.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Q3 seasonal pitch deck
cards.description:
Prepare a retail-focused pitch showing how Visiban tracks seasonal campaigns and store rollout projects.

Highlight swimlane-per-region use case.

checklist.text: Adapt standard deck for retail use case

cards.title: Proposal for 50 seats
cards.description:
Formal proposal sent 2026-03-12. Includes:

- 50 seats @ standard SMB pricing
- 30-day free trial extension
- Onboarding package (2 sessions)

CTO is reviewing with procurement.

comments.body: CTO out of office until Monday. Following up then.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Deal lost — budget frozen until Q4
cards.description:
Apex Retail CTO confirmed budget freeze effective immediately. Revisit in Q4 (October). Flagged for re-engagement campaign.

Reason: parent company M&A activity.

comments.body: Not a product rejection — purely budget. Good candidate for Q4 outreach.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Identify champion at Meridian
cards.description:
Need an internal champion with authority to push the deal. Current contact (IT Director) lacks budget sign-off.

Candidates: VP of Clinical Operations, CIO.

checklist.text: Request intro to CIO via IT Director

cards.title: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement
cards.description:
Meridian requires a signed HIPAA BAA before any data can be shared or a trial provisioned.

Our standard BAA covers PHI in transit and at rest. Have legal countersign and return within 5 business days.

checklist.text: Send standard BAA to their legal

comments.body: Their legal team has a 5-day turnaround. Starting clock today.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Pilot: 10 seats for 90 days
cards.description:
Pilot scoped to the Care Coordination team (10 seats). Success metrics:

- All active projects tracked in Visiban by day 30
- Monthly check-in NPS ≥ 35
- Expand to 200 seats if successful

comments.body: CIO approved pilot. Care Coordination team excited to start.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Contract signed — 200 seats
cards.description:
Meridian Health signed a 2-year contract for 200 seats. Annual value: $48k. Effective 2026-04-01.

Handoff to Customer Success for onboarding.

comments.body: Closed! 2-year deal. This is our biggest healthcare win to date.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Inbound lead — website form
cards.description:
Lead submitted via the website contact form. Message: 'Looking for a Trello replacement for our ops team.'

Assign to AE for same-day follow-up.

checklist.text: Qualify via email before booking call

comments.body: Responded within 20 min. They're evaluating 3 tools — we're in the mix.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Qualification call
cards.description:
15-min discovery call. Confirmed:

- 25 users across 3 ops teams
- Budget: ~$5k/year
- Decision by end of month
- Pain: Trello too simple, Jira too complex

comments.body: Great fit. Sending trial today.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Pricing discussion
cards.description:
Summit wants a 10% discount for annual pre-pay. Standard ACV for 25 seats is $3,000.

Approved to offer 10% for annual. No further discounting.

comments.body: They accepted the 10% annual pre-pay offer. Sending contract.
comments.author: demo1

cards.title: Closed — 25 seats annual
cards.description:
Summit Logistics signed for 25 seats on an annual plan. ACV: $2,700. Payment received. Provisioning complete.

Time to close: 9 days from inbound lead.

comments.body: Fastest close this quarter. Good template for SMB inbound.
comments.author: demo1
